texts.preamble: Kamta Prasad vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 January, 2024 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:5018 Court No. - 82 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 2923 of 2015 Revisionist :- Kamta Prasad Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Revisionist :- Ashish Pandey,Satya Prakash Rathor Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt.Advocate Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J. 1.
texts.arguments: It is pointed out that the accused is in custody in this case since 21.11.2023 in consequence of execution of warrants issued against him by this Court. It is contended by the revisionist that as per prosecution version, the sample of milk was found to have milk-fats and milk solids-non-fat contents below the prescribed level and that though, technically the matter comes within the definition provided for adulteration of food under Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, however, no adulterant of the nature injurious to health, was found in the sample. It is argued that the only allegation is that milk-fat and milk solids-non-fat were found 16% and 29% respectively, less then the prescribed minimum standards. It is said that this deficiency can be caused if a cattle is not fed with sufficient nutritious fodder and and there is a probability that this deficiency is attributable to the mixing of water with milk. Next contention is that the incident occurred in the year 2007 and since then, he was not found involved in any other offence, much less the offence of food adulteration. The accused is a farmer by profession and has been selling milk for earning some extra money. As the matter has become quite old, hence a lenient view as regard period of sentence should be taken. 5. Learned A.G.A. submits that the matter comes within the first proviso to section 16 which provides for punishments. The proviso to Section 16 says that the Court for any adequate and special reasons to be mentioned in the judgment award a sentence of imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than three months but which may extend to two years and with fine which shall not be less then Rs. 500/-, therefore, he cannot be punished for any period of sentence below three months. 6.
